name: toolkit
description: Sets up Toolkit V2 in a project: copies the model files, the chosen work tracking and memory skills, and their hooks.

interface.shortDescription: Set up a project with Toolkit V2, or check or update its setup.
interface.longDescription: Holds one skill, project-setup. It asks where to track work, which memory to use, and whether it is a Salesforce project, then copies the model project, the skills for those choices, three small hook commands, and their settings into the project. It also checks and updates an existing setup. The plugin itself has no hooks and no command, so it runs nothing in other projects.
defaultPrompt: Update the toolkit in this project
